in_hebrew.name: Bard
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Minstrel, composer, poet
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Bard הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old English 'bard', meaning a poet or composer. In Western tradition, the term 'bard' came to signify a skilled minstrel or storyteller. In Christianity, bards were often associated with the preservation and transmission of sacred stories and hymns.
